overview: Choose and bound a process before building it. A saved reflection alone does not establish method choice, a corrected checkpoint or a reviewable process map.
instructions: Use the supplied fictional monthly-review case; no personal example or real source document is required.
Compare working methods and explain the choice for the assigned task. The number of steps and amount of prose do not establish competence.
Ask the agent for help drafting if useful, then inspect the proposal and save your own corrected process map, rationale and bounded task brief.
Explain the intentional boundary errors and the evidence, reviewer and ordering in your correction. Do not execute or send anything for this design task.
Submit your saved design for automatic structured review when this assessment is available. Unclear evidence returns for learner revision; there is no staff grading queue.
Keep the approved map and original feedback for Workflow Design, or choose its provided example. Do not silently replace earlier work when the course changes.
